id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

buttons.description:
A list of buttons to display in the segment button group
Should be an array of 2-5 buttons

mode.description: What mode the segmented button should operate under

minOneSelected.description:
A configuration to ensure that at least one button is selected at all times.
if no value is set, then the first button will be selected.

height.description: The height of the segmented button

layout.description:
Whether the width should be 'full' - take up as much space as possible
and scale each button accordingly - or 'fixed' - each button takes up only the
space required with a fixed spacing on either side of the label/icon

value.description:
The value(s) that the segmented button will originally have selected.
If multiple are entered but the button is set to 'single-select', only
the first will be honored.

status.description: Extra status states that the segmented button could be in.

variant.description:
The variant of the segmented button, where 'outlined' has a border around each button, and 'ghost' has no border.
The default is 'outlined'.

title: Input component type for an atomic segmented button.
name: UiSdlAtomicSegmentedButton
